# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). In short: be respectful, assume good intent, and keep discussion about the work.

## Reporting

The maintainer, [@hnhan110](https://github.com/hnhan110), handles reports. To report privately, open a private report on the [Security tab](https://github.com/hnhan110/rustdesk-compact/security/advisories/new) and start the title with "Conduct:"; only the maintainer can see it. For harassment or spam, you can also use GitHub's **Report content** on the comment or account.

Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer may edit or remove comments, issues and pull requests, and block accounts, that break this code.
